_comment: Every performance number the README shows, measured once and written here once. scripts/bench-graph.py draws the charts from this file and checks the README's tables against it, so a chart and a table cannot drift apart. Re-measure with `cargo run --release --example throughput` and `cargo bench`, update here, then run `python3 scripts/bench-graph.py --write --check-readme`.
machine: Apple M3 Max (12P/4E), macOS 27.0, 64 GB, rustc 1.98.0, --release, rayon default pool of 16
method: Whole file in, RGB8 out. One warm-up discarded, best of nine, decoders run alternately, the cycle repeated five times, lowest reported.
